title: Cross-product tenant and environment context preservation
included_behaviors: preserve an authorized Tenant reference across a product transition
preserve an Environment reference only when it remains compatible with the destination
require a fresh destination authorization outcome before protected context is exposed
clear incompatible context on Tenant change without silent fallback
never carry raw payloads or secrets in the context envelope
excluded_behaviors: Tenant or Environment administrative lifecycle mutation
Context Bar or Inspector UI rendering
new permission IDs or Screen IDs

runtime_intent.authorization_model: authorization outcome is an explicit caller-supplied input; the pilot does not invent a policy engine

selection_rationale: MVP scope explicitly includes canonical objects and shell behavior
CAP-SET-004 is defined/planned and has no open decision
the selected behavior is Class 0/1 only and creates no business mutation

the slice exercises Product Spec traceability, tenant isolation, permissions, negative tests and cross-product context without requiring the unresolved query backend, forensic engines, or OPEN-013 mutation policy

rejected_candidates.reason: Case Queue depends on CAP-INV-102 plus Search/Saved Views; its dependency closure is larger and reaches OPEN-013
Case Lifecycle and Coordination explicitly depends on unresolved OPEN-013
Evidence Creation and Management explicitly depends on unresolved OPEN-013 and OPEN-014
